Asset: SMGIFT.BMP frame 022, one transparent cartoon sprite.
Image 1 is the current expression-v1 cartoon to edit. Image 2 is the exact original pose reference; its red-white dither represents skin. The user's clarified hand action takes priority over ambiguous tiny pixels.
Requested correction: Preserve the face exactly; the laughing expression is already correct. Rebuild BOTH arms naturally. The current front forearm is much too long, and the second hand looks as if it sprouts from it. Give the nearer/front arm a clearly bent elbow: upper arm descends from its visible shoulder to an elbow near the lower ribs, then a normal-length forearm rises diagonally to a hand just in front of the lower chest. Give the far arm its OWN shoulder, upper arm, separate visible bent elbow just to the right of the torso, forearm, wrist and hand. Show a separate continuous far forearm from that C-shaped hand down to its own elbow, with a visible contour gap separating it from the near wrist. Exactly two arms, two elbows, two wrists and two hands. Neither hand emerges from the other arm. Preserve the original compact playful gesture instead of a long reaching arm.
Lock the adult mermaid's cheerful face, golden blonde hair, turquoise hairband, tan skin, opaque green swimsuit top, cel shading and clean black outlines. Keep the same torso proportions, hair silhouette, waterline, ripples and submerged lower body. Change only the requested hand/arm geometry. No added props, anatomy or scenery. Output the complete sprite on actual RGBA transparency with comfortable clear margins. No checkerboard, labels, background or glow.
